hooks.command: $j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $fp = $j.tool_input.file_path; if ($fp) { $root = (Get-Location).Path.TrimEnd('\'); $rootFwd = $root -replace '\\','/'; $fpFwd = $fp -replace '\\','/'; $rel = $null; if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($fp)) { $rel = $fpFwd } elseif ($fpFwd.StartsWith($rootFwd + '/', [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { $rel = $fpFwd.Substring($rootFwd.Length + 1) }; if ($rel) { $q = '.claude\review-queue.txt'; if (!(Test-Path $q)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Path $q -Force | Out-Null }; $existing = Get-Content $q -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($existing -notcontains $rel) { Add-Content -Path $q -Value $rel } } }
hooks.statusMessage: Queuing file for Antigravity + Codex review...

hooks.command: $bd = Get-Command bd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($bd) { bd prime --work-type recovery } elseif (Test-Path '.beads\context\execution-state.md') { @{systemMessage='bd CLI not found. For recovery, read .beads/context/execution-state.md, .planning/STATE.md, and docs/context-router.md instead of running bd prime.'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }

$bd = Get-Command bd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($bd) { bd prime } elseif (Test-Path '.beads\context\execution-state.md') { @{systemMessage='bd CLI not found. Startup context is docs/context-router.md, .planning/STATE.md, and .beads/context/execution-state.md.'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }

$q = '.claude\review-queue.txt'; $pending = @(); if (Test-Path $q) { $pending = @(Get-Content $q -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }) }; if ($pending.Count -gt 0) { @{systemMessage='Reviewers needed before committing: check .claude/review-queue.txt, generate .claude/antigravity-prompt-latest.md and .claude/codex-prompt-latest.md, then have the user run Antigravity and Codex CLIs and save both review artifacts.'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }

$p = '.planning\stale-info-scan-latest.md'; $due = $true; if (Test-Path $p) { $due = ((New-TimeSpan -Start (Get-Item $p).LastWriteTime -End (Get-Date)).TotalDays -ge 30) }; if ($due) { @{systemMessage='Stale-information scan is due or missing: run /stale-info-scan before phase transitions, milestone close, release, or dependency/schema/harness changes.'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }
